correctness.rationale: Complete, reproducible enumeration of 824 nonempty faces via two logically independent membership tests; 411 exclusive Morse pairs; all 3244 Hasse cover relations reconstructed and acyclicity established by a topological sort of all 824 nodes. Exactly one 0-cell and one 3-cell remain, which proves S3 by discrete Morse theorem. Independent GF2 ranks match one H3 class, but are not used as a substitute for integral homotopy.

value.rationale: The Frucht graph is a canonical minimal cubic asymmetric graph rather than an arbitrary input. The first induced-component cutoff is the natural first enlargement of ordinary independence; its homotopy changes from the already-recorded wedge of three 2-spheres to one 3-sphere. The all-face matching supplies an exact and reproducible integral topological boundary example outside the classified complete multipartite/chordal/cycle families, not just a textbook Euler-count deduction.
